history.content: Am I ready for my Denver trip?

Mostly yes. Here's what I checked: Travel, per Southwest's confirmation email: WN 2214 JFK→DEN, Thu Oct 1, 3:40pm departure, and Zephyr Lodge with 3pm check in. That is staged as a draft for your confirmation — the calendar has not been changed yet. Calendar: Nothing on Oct 1 or 2, so no conflicts with the trip. Your week before is busy but clear of trip collisions: BigCo interview today at 2pm, dentist tomorrow 9am, standup and dinner with Dana on Wednesday. Loose ends from mail: 1. Dana · Panel details, panel is product + engineering leads, 45 min product case, bring questions. 100 Main St, 9th floor. Worth prepping before you fly. 2. Sarah · "Deck?", she's still waiting on the updated deck. She may ping again mid trip. 3. Sam · Contract, he said he'd review by Friday; no action needed from you yet. What I haven't checked: your reminders list and the weather for Denver, say the word and I'll pull both.
